findings.title: A successful result carries a do_instead field
findings.detail:
The taken_in:false value (exit 0) includes `do_instead: "norn sync"`, the field name of a CliError. A program that branches on the exit code is fine, but one that checks for `do_instead` to spot a refusal would misread it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally rename it to e.g. `next: "norn sync"` in the success value.

findings.title: cmd.storyCreate does not escape a title with a double quote in it
findings.detail:
`--title "${o.title}"` prints a command that cannot be pasted when the title contains `"`. It is only used in do_instead hints after the editor fails.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Quote with the same helper other printed commands use, if one exists, or leave it.
